behaviorLimits.unknownOrUnimplementedFact: Explicit error and faulted actor; no successful empty batch.

behaviorLimits.terminalOrdering: Per-event canonical validation only. The pinned projection maps failure after a finished terminal; single-terminal enforcement belongs to AgentUI run coordination (agentui-7s6y/agentui-ckpw).
behaviorLimits.qualification: Fixture registration and retained evidence inventory are not current execution results or native qualification.
behaviorLimits.downstream: Provider operation contracts/admission: agentui-k4zj/agentui-7s6y. Full native, transport/replay and UI qualification: agentui-ckpw.
